first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a targeted onboarding simplification the strongest direct response and one supported by prior evidence. Verify memory_86 before committing, then run a small guarded test with qualified-revenue and retention guardrails to detect any downstream quality loss.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, directly addressing the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline. The verified source shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention. Monitor qualified revenue, activation quality, and retention as guardrails so improved completion does not create lower-value accounts.
